regime_context: The Hong Kong thematic detector shows a narrow leadership with Tech Hardware & Semis at rank 1 (trend, eligible, low breadth) amid a validated absolute-trend gate that historically cut drawdowns. Several other trend-eligible themes like High-Dividend Blue Chips and Industrials also pass the gate, while Banks (eligible but mean-reverting) and many ineligible themes fall below. Macro headlines remain dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics, but the signal is noisy (unscheduled share 0.92). One prior call was a hit, but the sample is tiny; lean low across the board.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: The market's prevailing price-leadership theme passes the absolute-trend gate (durability 0.63, Hurst 'trend') and shows no crowding. While the rank itself is not a return forecast, the trend discipline suggests a lower drawdown/volatility profile. Low breadth (0.167) warns that leadership rests on a thin base, capping conviction.
evidence: Absolute-trend gate passed: durability_bar 0.63, Hurst tag 'trend'
